name: Share of stocks above their averages
derivation: B's average is missing for the first two sessions. It is excluded from the numerator AND the denominator, so sessions 1 and 2 are 1/1 = 1 (A alone, above). On session 3 B's average arrives at 20 against a close of 10, so B is below and the ratio is 1/2 = 0.5. Counting an unwarmed member as 'not above' would report 0.5 on every session - a statement about listing dates rather than about breadth.
